Package com.platform.media_service.controllers

Class FileController

java.lang.Object
com.platform.media_service.controllers.FileController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/media") public class FileController extends Object
Controller class for managing file operations such as saving files and retrieving file details. This class provides RESTFUL endpoints for uploading files and fetching file metadata based on UUID.

  • Method Details

    • getFile

      @GetMapping("/getFile/{uuid}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<byte[]> getFile(@PathVariable String uuid)
      Retrieves the file as a byte array by UUID and returns it in the response, along with file metadata in the headers. The file is returned as "application/octet-stream".
      Parameters:
      uuid - the unique identifier (UUID) of the file.
      Returns:
      the file data as bytes and metadata in headers.

    • getFileBase64

      @GetMapping("/getFileBase64/{uuid}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<FileResponseDto> getFileBase64(@PathVariable String uuid)
      Retrieves file data by UUID, returning it in Base64 format and metadata within a DTO.
      Parameters:
      uuid - the unique identifier of the file.
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity containing the file data in Base64 and metadata.

    • saveFile

      @PostMapping(value="/savefile", consumes="multipart/form-data") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<UuidResponseDto> saveFile(@RequestPart("file") org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file, @RequestPart(value="hashMd5",required=false) String hashMd5, @RequestPart(value="hashSha256",required=false) String hashSha256)
      Uploads a file.
      Parameters:
      file - the file to upload
      hashMd5 - optional MD5 hash for verification
      hashSha256 - optional SHA-256 hash for verification
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing the UuidResponseDto with the UUID of the saved file
